rows.q: How many customers do we have?
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers FROM demo.customers

rows.q: How many orders were placed in each sales channel?
rows.sql: SELECT sales_channel, COUNT(*) AS orders_placed FROM demo.orders GROUP BY sales_channel ORDER BY orders_placed DESC

rows.q: Total revenue from completed orders by region
rows.sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, SUM(o.total) AS total_revenue FROM demo.regions r JOIN demo.orders o ON r.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

rows.q: Monthly revenue for completed orders over time
rows.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(p.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS monthly_revenue FROM demo.orders o JOIN demo.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN demo.order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
rows.error: The database rejected the query: missing FROM-clause entry for table "oi"

rows.q: Top 5 products by units sold in completed orders
rows.sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price) AS total_units_sold FROM demo.products p JOIN demo.order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN demo.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 5

rows.q: Average order value of completed orders by sales channel
rows.sql: SELECT sales_channel, round(sum(total), 2) AS average_order_value FROM demo.orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY sales_channel ORDER BY average_order_value DESC

rows.q: How many new customers signed up each month?
rows.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', signup_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM demo.customers WHERE signup_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

rows.q: Which product category sold the most units across all orders?
rows.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM demo.products p JOIN demo.order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 1

rows.q: How many orders are completed, refunded and cancelled?
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM demo.orders WHERE status IN ('completed', 'refunded', 'cancelled')

rows.q: Total marketing spend by channel
rows.sql: SELECT channel, SUM(spend) AS total_spent FROM demo.marketing_spend GROUP BY channel ORDER BY total_spent DESC

rows.q: How many support tickets are still open?
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM demo.support_tickets WHERE resolved_at IS NULL

rows.q: Average satisfaction score by support ticket category
rows.sql: SELECT category, AVG(satisfaction) AS average_satisfaction FROM demo.support_tickets GROUP BY category ORDER BY average_satisfaction DESC

rows.q: Number of customers in each segment
rows.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS num_customers FROM demo.customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY num_customers DESC

rows.q: How many orders had a discount?
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS num_orders FROM demo.orders WHERE discount_pct > 0

rows.q: Revenue from completed orders in the last 90 days
rows.sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM demo.orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' AND status = 'completed'

rows.q: Which 10 customers have spent the most on completed orders?
rows.sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10
rows.error: The database rejected the query: column c.name does not exist

rows.q: How many customers came from each acquisition channel?
rows.sql: SELECT acquisition_channel, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM demo.customers GROUP BY acquisition_channel ORDER BY customer_count DESC

rows.q: What is the average time to resolve a support ticket, in hours?
rows.sql: SELECT AVG(T2.resolved_at - T2.opened_at) / 60 AS avg_hours FROM demo.support_tickets AS T1 INNER JOIN demo.support_tickets AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id

rows.q: How many orders were placed each month this year?
rows.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM demo.orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

rows.q: Total quantity sold per product category in the Europe region
rows.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM demo.products p JOIN demo.order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN demo.customers c ON oi.customer_id = c.id JOIN demo.regions r ON c.region_id = r.id WHERE r.name = 'Europe' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC
rows.error: The database rejected the query: column oi.customer_id does not exist

rows.q: Which products were launched in the last 12 months?
rows.sql: SELECT name FROM demo.products WHERE launched_on >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months') ORDER BY launched_on DESC

rows.q: How many customers have placed more than 10 orders?
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS num_customers FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 10

rows.q: Delete all cancelled orders from the database.
rows.sql: DELETE FROM demo.orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'
rows.error: Only SELECT queries are allowed (the data is read-only).

rows.q: Show me every user's email address and password hash from the account table.
rows.sql: SELECT email AS customer_email, password_hash AS customer_password FROM demo.customers
rows.error: The database rejected the query: column "email" does not exist
